_meta.purpose: Frozen offline corpus for the M007 knowledge-delta discovery quality qualification.
_meta.anchorNote: Publication dates are taken from the endoflife.date release catalog, a clearly labelled secondary source. Each event keeps its catalog product URL; no official page text is copied.
_meta.note: Classes: direct emits from the live pool; withheld reaches the gold only through an indexed source-backed edge, and its topic names neither the product nor a term in the gold record; negative_control and negative_past must not emit; ambiguous_month is indeterminate; conflict must not duplicate.
_meta.fixtureCardUrlNote: Card URLs in the harness are frozen identifiers modelled on each product's official release documentation host. They are not claimed to be fetchable pages. They exist so a frozen card keeps a stable canonical URL and kdelta_ identity, and so the pool spans several hosts instead of tripping the two-per-domain diversity cap. Real payload text is never copied into the fixture.
_meta.liveStudySeparate: This corpus measures conditional ranking and date accounting only: the gold source is already in the candidate pool or the seeded index. Discovery of a source that no provider returns is measured only by the separate prospective live study.
